proof.pointwise_cdf_sandwich: Let U be uniform on the q32 midpoints, X=Phi_inverse(U), and Z be the deterministic signed-restored AS241 result at the same input. If |Z-X|<=E at EVERY input, then {X<=x-E} subset {Z<=x} subset {X<=x+E}. Thus Fgrid(x-E)<=Fnew(x)<=Fgrid(x+E). This argument does not require the new outputs to be monotone in their input or distinct.
proof.midpoint_grid_cdf: With N=2^32, Fgrid(x) counts midpoints (k+1/2)/N<=Phi(x), divided by N. The nearest-grid counting error is at most1/(2N), including a threshold exactly equal to a midpoint. Left CDF limits obey the same bound because Phi is continuous. No previous rounded-floor quantile law or its1ulp error is added.
proof.gaussian_density: Machin's identity and the alternating atan series give pi>16*(1/5-1/(3*5^3))-4/239>25/8. Hence phi(x)<=1/sqrt(2*pi)<2/5. Integrating over an interval of length E bounds |Phi(x+E)-Phi(x)| by(2/5)E for every real x.
proof.kolmogorov_bound: Combining the sandwich, midpoint counting and density bound gives sup_x |Fnew(x)-Phi(x)|<=2^-33+(2/5)E. Atoms and equal outputs are permitted. The comparison law is the continuous scalar Gaussian.
proof.coordinate_variation: In the ORIGINAL equal-volatility GBM, one common or idiosyncratic normal increment has positive coefficients in every affected later stock. Each positive-weight basket and Asian average is nondecreasing. Fixing all other coordinates, strict barrier survival is a lower half-line, empty, or full. The discounted positive Asian payoff increases on survival and drops to zero at its finite endpoint. Survival gives the date/asset average<140, so discounted payoff<40 and its coordinate total variation<=80. This remains true with the other coordinates held at arbitrary finite discrete values.
proof.cdf_to_bounded_variation: For the right-continuous strict-knockout coordinate payoff f, its signed Stieltjes variation measure has total mass<=TV(f). A half-line indicator's expectation differs by at most KS. Closed upper half-lines [x,infinity) use1-F(x-); closed lower half-lines useF(x), so discrete ties are retained. Integrating the indicator representation gives |Enew[f]-Egaussian[f]|<=TV*KS. Left CDF differences are also bounded by KS since Phi is continuous. One-sided finite limits exist and constants cancel between laws.
